name: Gathering of the Ghouls
blurb: Arizona's annual Halloween and horror convention at the Mesa Convention Center, with horror celebrities, cosplay contests and haunted attractions.
notes: The homepage itself says the 2026 edition (Aug 22-23) 'HAS ENDED' and reads 'WHO'S READY FOR GHOULS 2027? Vendor and convention info coming soon!' — so the next edition is confirmed to be happening but its dates are not yet announced.
